items.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Commits To 1 Million Free Emergency Housing Nights Each Year
items.summary: Airbnb (NasdaqGS:ABNB) has formalized Airbnb.org as an independent nonprofit focused on emergency housing support for people in crisis. The organization is launching a program targeting 1 million free emergency housing nights each year for displaced guests worldwide. A new funding mechanism tied to each Airbnb booking is expected to provide ongoing financial support for Airbnb.org’s relief efforts.
